title: Bound the Claude gate-write guard's protection of an ended-but-unsettled gate whose holder never checkpoints
outcome: A gate read as terminal whose holder never reaches a settling checkpoint does not deny Claude file writes into its worktree for the whole 6-hour carried-check TTL, and the denial says how to clear it.
acceptance: Bound the Claude gate-write guard's protection of an ended-but-unsettled gate whose holder never checkpoints is done
